meta.title: The 100-Reviewer Panel

criteria.label: Clarity
criteria.desc: Information hierarchy, H1 scale, above-the-fold comprehension in <2s, KPI/verdict legibility.

criteria.label: Distinctness
criteria.desc: Unique geometry and narrative vs siblings; anti-drift / not an identical skin.

criteria.label: Accessibility
criteria.desc: Keyboard paths, ARIA, focus management, reduced motion, AA contrast, skip links, live regions.

criteria.label: Responsive
criteria.desc: 360/390/768/1024/1440 reflow, mobile card fallback, sticky behaviour, no horizontal scroll.

criteria.label: Performance
criteria.desc: Page weight, inline script size, zero external requests, zero image payload.

criteria.label: Interaction
criteria.desc: Real working interactions: command palette, sort, stepper, live preview, board nav, dropzone.

criteria.label: State coverage
criteria.desc: Populated, empty, loading/skeleton, error+retry, success, cancel-without-losing-work.

criteria.label: Guidance
criteria.desc: Help affordances, inline validation, tooltips, budget guide, word count, in-context hints.

criteria.label: Honesty
criteria.desc: No invented rows/rates/APIs; demo-labelled CTAs; frozen-content fidelity; audit-truthful copy.

criteria.label: Consistency
criteria.desc: One token scheme, light/dark parity, brand discipline, semantic HTML, reduced-motion parity.

meta.method: Deterministic seeded simulation of 100 distinct personas; NOT real human research.
meta.limits: Criterion ratings come from static code analysis + documented design facts. No screenshot/browser/real-user testing was performed.

variants.name: Calm Ledger
variants.tag: Airy single-col ledger · chips + URL state + focus-trapped drawer

variants.name: Ops Console
variants.tag: Dense sticky table · aria-sort · ⌘K · density toggle · mobile cards

variants.name: Attention Queue
variants.tag: Verdict hero · count-up KPIs · priority switch · Review next

variants.name: Chapter Tabs
variants.tag: Sticky rail · scroll-spy · narrative chapters · in-page jumps

variants.name: Status Lanes
variants.tag: 4 counted lanes · roving arrow-key board · read-only by design

variants.name: Classic Brief
variants.tag: Single column · help popovers · autosave/restore · completion count

variants.name: Three Steps
variants.tag: Gated wizard · aria-current=step · per-step validation · lossless Back

variants.name: Compact Desk
variants.tag: 12-col dense grid · native details help · live budget-band ruler

variants.name: Guided Narrative
variants.tag: Sticky TOC · scroll-spy · word count · resume-draft banner

variants.name: Bento Split
variants.tag: Bento accordion · sticky live request-card preview · autosave
